concerns.text: Task T005a (Dataset Loaders) depends on T005b (Backoff), but T005b is marked [P] (parallel-safe). T005a cannot run in parallel with T005b if it explicitly depends on the backoff wrapper implementation. The [P] tag on T005b is misleading if T005a is intended to run concurrently, as T005a requires T005b's code to be present. Furthermore, T005a depends on T005b, yet T005b is listed before T005a in the phase, which is correct, but the [P] tag implies no dependencies exist for T005b, which is true, but the dependency chain T005a -> T005b means T005a cannot be parallel with T005b. The real issue is T006 depends on T005a, and T005a depends on T005b. The [P] tags on T005a and T005b are contradictory to the explicit DEPENDS ON clauses.

Task T014 (Distinctness Validation) depends on T013 (Schema Definition). T013 is marked [P]. T014 is marked [P]. However, T014 explicitly consumes the artifact (Pydantic model) produced by T013. If T013 and T014 are run in parallel, T014 will fail because the schema does not exist yet. The [P] tag on T014 is incorrect as it has a hard dependency on T013.

Task T037 (Prompt Template) depends on T013 (Schema) and T006 (Model Loading). T037 is marked [P]. T013 and T006 are also marked [P]. However, T037 cannot be executed in parallel with T013 or T006 because it requires the schema definition and model loading logic to be complete to construct the prompt template correctly (as per its description: 'using schema from T013 and prompt template from T037' - wait, T037 IS the prompt template. It says 'DEPENDS ON T013, T006'). The [P] tag on T037 is invalid because it has explicit dependencies on T013 and T006.

Task T015 (Parse Proposal) depends on T013, T006, T037. T015 is marked [US1] but not [P]. However, T016 (Apply Modification) depends on T013. T016 is marked [US1] but not [P]. T017a (Training Loop) depends on T008 (Config). T017a is not marked [P]. The ordering within US1 seems correct (T015 -> T016 -> T017a), but the dependency on T008 (Config) for T017a is critical. T008 is in Phase 2. If T008 is not completed before T017a, T017a will fail. The task list shows T008 in Phase 2, which is correct, but the [P] tag on T008 implies it can run in parallel with other Phase 2 tasks. This is fine, but T017a must wait for T008.

Task T020 (Orchestrate Cycle) depends on T013, T014, T008, T007, T010, T017a, T018, T019, T044, T036, T037b, T059, T090. T020 is the final integration task for US1. It correctly lists all dependencies. However, T044 (Retry Logic) depends on T090 (Attempt Counter) and T009 (Logging). T036 (Early Stop) depends on T009. T037b (Validation) depends on T010, T015, T037. T059 (Oracle) depends on T010. The dependency chain is deep. The [P] tags on T044, T036, T037b, T059, T090 are all present. This is a major violation: T044 depends on T090, so they cannot be parallel. T036 depends on T009, so they cannot be parallel. T037b depends on T010, T015, T037, so it cannot be parallel with them. T059 depends on T010, so it cannot be parallel with T010. The [P] tags on these tasks are incorrect and will lead to race conditions if executed in parallel.

Task T025 (Main Loop) depends on T013, T029, T014, T020, T044, T036, T026, T059, T090. T025 is marked [US2] but not [P]. T026 (Distinct Modification) depends on T013, T029, T014. T026 is marked [US2] but not [P]. T027 (Linear Regression) depends on T007. T027 is marked [US2] but not [P]. T029 (Trajectory Schema) depends on T013, T027. T029 is marked [US2] but not [P]. The dependency T029 -> T027 is correct (schema needs regression results). However, T025 depends on T020 (US1) and T026 (US2). This implies US2 cannot start until US1 is complete, which contradicts the 'User Story Dependencies' section that says 'US2 (P2) ... depends on US1 components' but also 'All user stories can start in parallel (if team capacity allows)'. The task dependencies enforce a serial execution (US1 -> US2), which is safer but contradicts the parallel opportunity claim. The [P] tags on T025, T026, T027, T029 are missing, which is correct given their dependencies, but the 'Parallel Opportunities' section claims 'Once Foundational phase completes, all user stories can start in parallel'. This is a semantic contradiction: the tasks enforce serial execution, but the plan claims parallel execution.

Task T031 (Trade-off Metrics) depends on T030, T048. T031 is marked [US3] but not [P]. T030 (FLOPs Aggregation) depends on T017b. T030 is marked [US2] but not [P]. T048 (Resource Monitoring) depends on T004. T048 is marked [US3] but not [P]. T033 (Generate Analysis) depends on T031. T033 is marked [US3] but not [P]. The dependency chain T033 -> T031 -> T030/T048 is correct. However, T030 is in US2, T031 and T033 are in US3. This implies US3 depends on US2 completion, which is consistent with the 'User Story Dependencies' section. The [P] tags are correctly absent.

Task T109 (Fixed-Point Convergence) is a duplicate of T116 (Fixed-Point Convergence Check). T109 is in Phase 6, T116 is in Phase 2. Both have the same description and verification. This is a semantic ordering violation: T116 is in Phase 2 (Foundational), T109 is in Phase 6 (Polish). If T116 is the foundational implementation, T109 is redundant. If T109 is the intended implementation, T116 is misplaced. The duplication creates ambiguity in the execution order and artifact ownership.
